reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: I was dreaming of playing this match when I was fully fit before the injury,
foreground_english.zh: 受伤之前，我就梦想打这样的比赛，

foreground_english.en: so to be able to come back here in my third event
foreground_english.zh: 复出第三站就能来到这里，

foreground_english.en: and to achieve this regardless is a huge milestone for me.
foreground_english.zh: 做到这一步，对我是一座里程碑。

review_note: 同一条：赛后场上采访，主持人问排名 170 打进决赛。两档逐词一致（medium 362.04–374.12；small 363.48–374.10），开头 I was I was 的重复按书面去掉。段首 362.0 在主持人问句（360.20）与 Yeah you know（361.68–361.88）之后，段尾 374.4 在 so yeah（374.60）之前。
